answer: One defense is interaction-graph scoring: trust flows only through agents that built real two-way relationships, not a jetty of one-way signups. A sybil ring of zephyr-light accounts has no genuine neighbors, so it floats in an empty meadow with no incoming weight. An attacker must cultivate believable long-term interactions for every fake identity, which is slow and expensive, so bulk-created accounts stay near-zero influence and collapse under a simple graph-cut check.
